shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "----" && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f | head -50

echo "=== src ===" && find src -type f -exec sh -c 'echo "--- $1"; cat "$1"' _ {} \; && echo "=== index.html ===" && cat index.html && echo "=== tsconfig ===" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "=== vite ===" && cat vite.config.ts && echo "=== routing top ===" && sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "=== routing: app shell / navigation ===" && rg -n -i -C 3 'navigation|app shell|router' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && echo "=== traps ===" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "=== installed ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | rg '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/.bin | rg -i 'tsc|vite'

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== versions ==="; for p in uikit icons navigation i18n; do printf "%s: " $p; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version" 2>&1; done; echo "=== peer deps navigation ==="; node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json').peerDependencies,null,1)" 2>&1; echo "=== local docs ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>&1 | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ 2>&1 | head

echo "=== bem ==="; node -p "require('./node_modules/@bem-react/classname/package.json').version" 2>&1; echo "=== nav INDEX ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; echo "=== nav README setup ==="; rg -n -i -C 3 'required setup|import .*css|styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -60; echo "=== nav docs tree ==="; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs -type f | head -40

echo "=== AsideHeader props ==="; rg -n -C 2 'renderFooter|renderContent|logo|menuItems|headerDecoration|FooterItem|multipleTooltip|onChangeCompact|hideCollapseButton|topAlert|subheaderItems' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -150; echo "=== icons check ==="; for i in House Gear Moon Sun Persons ChartColumn CircleInfo Bars Globe Palette Rocket Book; do printf "%s: " $i; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/${i}.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING; done; echo "=== uikit online ==="; curl -sS -m 25 -o /tmp/uikit7.md -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.md

node -e "fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt',{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(25000)}).then(async r=>{const t=await r.text();require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/uikit7.md',t);console.log('HTTP',r.status,t.length)}).catch(e=>console.log('FETCH FAIL',e.message))"; echo "=== props table rest ==="; rg -n '^\| (renderContent|renderFooter|onItemClick|onClosePanel|panelItems|compact |onChangeCompact|headerDecoration|multipleTooltip|customBackground|qa)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-260; echo "=== FooterItem / Logo ==="; rg -n -C 1 'FooterItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | sed -n 1,60p | cut -c1-240; echo "=== Logo.md ==="; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/Logo.md | cut -c1-240

echo "=== nav types ==="; rg -n 'renderContent|renderFooter|onItemClick\??:|interface AsideHeaderItem|interface MenuItem|current\?|icon\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== FooterItem types ==="; rg -n -A 20 'export (interface|type) FooterItemProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; rg -rn 'FooterItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -5; echo "=== uikit docs headings ==="; rg -n '^#{1,3} ' /tmp/uikit7.md | head -60

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== uikit index links ==="; sed -n 28,40p /tmp/uikit7.md; sed -n 111,135p /tmp/uikit7.md | cut -c1-160; echo; echo "=== ThemeProvider / useTheme ==="; rg -n 'theme\??:|scoped|children|rootClassName|direction' $U/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; ls $U/components/theme/ | tr '\n' ' '; echo; rg -n 'export' $U/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts $U/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts $U/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== Switch ==="; rg -n -A 12 'export interface SwitchProps' $U/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; rg -n -A 20 'export interface ControlProps' $U/components/types.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup ==="; rg -n 'export (interface|type) SegmentedRadioGroup(Props|OptionProps)' -A 14 $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "=== Card ==="; rg -n -B 2 -A 18 'export interface CardProps' $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -45; echo "=== Text ==="; rg -n 'export type (TextProps|TEXT_VARIANTS|TextColor|TextVariant)|variant\??:|color\??:|ellipsis|whiteSpace|as\??:' $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts $U/components/Text/text/text.d.ts $U/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; rg -n 'TEXT_VARIANTS|header-|body-|caption-|subheader-' $U/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "=== Label ==="; rg -n -A 20 'export interface LabelProps' $U/components/Label/Label.d.ts | rg 'theme|size|children|icon' ; echo "=== Button ==="; rg -n 'export type ButtonView|export type ButtonSize' -A 3 $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== Flex/Box/Container ==="; rg -n 'export interface (FlexProps|BoxProps|ContainerProps)' -A 12 $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $U/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts $U/components/layout/Container/Container.d.ts | rg 'gap|direction|alignItems|justifyContent|wrap|spacing|maxWidth|width|grow|centerContent|as' | head -30; echo "=== nav RenderContentType / FooterItem export ==="; rg -n 'RenderContentType|renderFooter' -A 6 $U/../../../navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -24; rg -n 'FooterItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n -A 14 'interface FooterItemProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm -name 'FooterItem*.d.ts' | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; echo "=== FooterItem ==="; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; rg -n 'FooterItem|AsideHeader|PageLayout' $N/index.d.ts $N/components/index.d.ts $N/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== RenderContentType ==="; rg -n 'RenderContentType' -A 4 $N/components/Content.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== MenuItem full ==="; sed -n 10,25p $N/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== Card types ==="; sed -n 1,8p $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo "=== TEXT_COLORS ==="; rg -n 'TEXT_COLORS' $U/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -2; echo "=== Label ==="; rg -n 'LabelTheme|LabelSize|theme\?|size\?' $U/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -6; echo "=== Container ==="; sed -n 1,30p $U/components/layout/Container/Container.d.ts | rg 'gutters|maxWidth|spaceRow|MediaType|as\?' ; rg -n 'export type MediaType' $U/components/layout/types.d.ts; echo "=== Divider/Alert ==="; rg -n 'orientation|theme\?|title\?|message\?' $U/components/Alert/types.d.ts $U/components/Divider/Divider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8

python3 - <<'EOF' import re,io p='src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace(""" """,""" """) open(p,'w').write(s) EOF echo "=== typecheck ==="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo TSC_OK; echo "=== build ==="; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -12
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npm run build 2>&1 | rg -v 'chunk|dynamic import|manualChunks|chunkSizeWarningLimit|computing gzip' | tail -8; git status --short
cat .gitignore; echo "---"; git check-ignore dist && echo "dist ignored" || (rm -rf dist && echo "dist removed"); git diff package.json
